title: TCG:OAL-098

power.text:
Heroes in this zone cannot ready after the start of a round and gain "Swing - Exhaust Action: Put the Pendulum 1 or 2 zones forward. You may target a ready enemy hero in that zone. If you do, it picks up the Pendulum." 
 If the Pendulum is with a hero, only that hero can swing.
